content:
Noah: question for the watercooler crowd  if the core open models were your flatmates, who leaves dishes in the sink and who labels the Tupperware? :thought_balloon:
Sana: Mistral leaves a stack of mysterious snacks in the sink and denies ownership. chaotic roommate energy. :raccoon:
Priya: Llama2 is the one who labels everything and makes a chore rota but also buys flowers sometimes. :bouquet:
Luis: Falcon is that cool, quiet roommate who uses all your good mugs and returns them dry but cold. also naps in the sun spot. :cat:
Noah: tiny improv prompt idea: write a 2-line note from your model-roommate demanding rent in tokens. winner gets sticker.
Sana: my note:
```
Hey human, rent due: 1000 tokens. If late, I will cache your breakfast and only return it after a softmax apology.
```
Priya: haha love. merch idea: "Modelroommate Docket" fridge magnet with tiny chores: "Feed cache, refill snacks, do nightly stress test once/week."
Luis: quick poll  react with :raccoon: if your model-roommate is chaotic, :dog2: if loyal-helper, :cat: if aloof, :owl: if wise and passive-aggressive
Noah: side note: someone actually named a VM "mistral-dishes" and my pager keeps waking me up with "someone left a log in the sink". true story. :sweat_smile:
Sana: @DeployBot please confirm: can we rename hosts to something boring like "infra-xyz" so my dreams are not haunted by raccoons?
DeployBot: Automated reminder  hostname rename policy requires 48 hours and an infra ticket. Please open #eng-infra.
Priya: idea for the lunch event: "Which model would your landlord be?" quick entries welcome. winner gets bagels & a tiny enamel pin.
Luis: mini-game for lunch: teams write a 1-line eviction notice written by a model and read them aloud. funniest gets a sticker. rules: keep it PG and no real hosts referenced.
Noah: TL;DR: Mistral steals snacks, Llama2 labels, Falcon naps, OpenAssistant hides your stapler and leaves a note. also someone pls adopt my raccoon plush.
lunchbot: Heads up  "Model Housemates" lunch slot scheduled for next Thursday. Catering: bagels + fruit. Budget owner: @PeopleOps.
Sana: last remark: someone should design a tiny "I complied with the cache" certificate we can give to victorious teams. prize = eternal bragging rights.
Priya: I will 3D-print a mini Tupperware trophy if PeopleOps approves budget.
Luis: vote summary (informal): :raccoon: 7, :dog2: 3, :cat: 4, :owl: 2. Mistral wins Most Likely to Leave Dishes.
Noah: cool. thanks everyone. also serious ask: @DeployBot ticket submitted. can we get host rename guidance in #eng-infra?
DeployBot: Ticket #INF-4721 opened. Expect guidance within 24h.
